subtitle: SOVEREIGN WORLD ATLAS — Curated Site-Wide Art & Cinematic Visual Unification

Strengthened distinct cinematic research headers for Sovereign Ascension, Character Intelligence, Progression Intelligence, Azeroth Assistant and Addon Nexus using studio-specific, source-safe portrait art.

Gave the original main companion's Overview, Characters, Build Architect, Progression, Collections and Data & Backup workspaces distinctive illustrated headers without modifying JS-owned forms or saved records.
Preserved the Assassin Dominion Developer Identity, v10 Command Center, v11 Sovereign Player Experience, and both alternate cinematic entrances while aligning their decorative trims.
Added a focused protective-guardian cover treatment to Save Protection, limiting portraits to approximately 300px while keeping true HD landscape artwork as the full-width background.
Preserved authentication, Blizzard Worker, local storage schemas, forms, talent research, music player, official release manifests and previous rollback branches.

Staging update only; real iPhone/desktop visual and functional acceptance are still required before public Discord release.
Added the independent v11 Sovereign Player Experience, accessible from the cinematic Command Center, full companion sidebar and Sovereign Ascension.

Added Talent Build Intelligence 2.0 with side-by-side node-ID and rank allocation comparison, specialization-identity safeguards, JSON draft export, independent historical checkpoints and manual draft association.
Added a character-specific Adventure Log with create, complete and remove controls, while preserving original companion tasks, collection goals and v10 Command Board in read-only displays.
Added a Save Protection Center to export supported whitelisted local planning records without accessing authentication tokens or overwriting existing browser data.
Created a rollback branch for v10.0; kept original Cloudflare authentication, Blizzard Workers, talent engine, character records, music and save formats unchanged.
Expanded Command Center navigation and search to surface the new player experience and backup center, retaining Citadel and Living Azeroth alternate entrances.
Kept all new state in four separate v11 browser-local keys and respected mobile responsive behavior, device performance and reduced-motion settings.
Scripted checks covered character loading, draft comparison, checkpoint saving, draft association and character-specific goal creation. Real-device acceptance is still pending.
Introduced the v10 Living Command Center as the first-visit homepage while preserving the original full companion and its dedicated legacy Citadel and Living Azeroth entrances.

Created a distinctive HD 1600x900 Citadel hero, sovereign feature portrait, five illustrated chamber destinations using existing repository artwork, responsive interactive layouts and subtle optional snowfall.
Added browser-local character roster and saved build draft previews from established companion storage keys, clearly labeled as manual records and never claimed as verified game-account data.

Added a separately namespaced v10 Adventure Board with editable completion state, protected deletion, a 120-goal limit, and a downloadable JSON export; earlier companion tasks and collection plans remain read-only.
Added universal local command search (Ctrl/Cmd+K) covering existing studios, saved characters, build drafts, personal objectives and collection goals, with no new server requests.
Included recent companion view continuation, obvious links back to all original tools, and a dedicated Command Center shortcut inside the main application.
Preserved Cloudflare account verification, Blizzard research endpoints, existing talent allocations, collections, music, storage schema and user site branding. No new credentials or infrastructure.
Adapted controls, thumbnails and particles for desktop and iPhone, respecting reduced motion, low-power preferences and inactive browser tabs.

Introduced the additive v9.4 luxury visual layer across the main companion, Citadel, Living Azeroth, Sovereign Ascension, Character Intelligence, Progression Intelligence, Oracle and Addon Nexus.

Preserved the existing five chamber illustrations and sharp HD Citadel panorama, with meaningful individual warm-gold, frost-blue, violet, adventure and oracle accents rather than generic replacement art.
Refined cinematic portrait cards, lighting, readability, keyboard focus preservation and desktop hover elevation without changing studio links, forms or player-facing functionality.

Introduced small contained scene-matched hero particles on external studios only (snow/frost, embers or arcane glow), automatically respecting reduced motion, data saver, low-memory devices and the existing performance preference.

Paused decorative particles on hidden tabs, reduced their counts on mobile and disabled costly mobile panel backdrop blur; kept the Citadel and Living Azeroth existing particle engines instead of stacking duplicates.

Improved Loot Hunter, Armory, Talent Forge, progression, dashboards, collection records, metric tiles, forms and research cards with better contrast and interaction cues.
